title: Keep native jobs progressing
applies_when: Colonists are idle while useful work is intended or queued.
approach: Check whether the work is actually designated, billed or placed before changing worker priorities.
Inspect disabilities, enabled work, materials, access and current targets. Native reservations can indicate another worker is already attending to the job.
Use work priorities and schedules for ordinary labor. Numeric priorities require the native manual-priorities setting. Do not invent a forced job for ordinary work.
verify: Remaining deliveries, frame work and completions across observations.
Native current jobs and idle flags; a target alone does not prove progress.
reconsider: No eligible workers, missing ingredients, unreachable work, or continued lack of observed progress.
